prospective_policy.initialization: FLAT on first evaluated session, known_peak=that first Close. Earlier complete authorized sessions supply variance only and do not seed FLAT/ARMED/HELD state.
prospective_policy.sigma_definition: sigma_T=std(logC_s-logC_s-1 for lastL complete returns endingT),ddof0. Insufficient history is explicitNaN/unavailable; zero sigma stays zero/unavailable. No epsilon/fill/shorter window. FLAT tracks peak but cannot arm when current sigma unavailable.
prospective_policy.lock_time: Episode starts exactly atT close when the FLAT excursion arm condition passes. Freeze sigma0=sigma_T at that arm decision, not at previous peak, not on later buy/reversal confirmation, and never update it through ARMED orHELD. It clears only at the cycle's SELL target0 decision.
prospective_policy.FLAT: Update peak=max(previous peak,C_T). If log(peak)-log(C_T)>=2*k*sigma_T and current sigma available, becomeARMED with trough=C_T/sigma_locked=sigma_T, target0. Otherwise stayFLAT, target0. An arm day cannot simultaneously buy.
prospective_policy.ARMED: Update trough=min(previous trough,C_T). If log(C_T)-log(trough)>=k*sigma0, target1 and becomeHELD with peak=C_T; clear trough but retain sigma0. Otherwise stayARMED target0. No expiry or additional gate.
prospective_policy.HELD: Update peak=max(previous peak,C_T). If log(peak)-log(C_T)>=k*sigma0, target0 and resetFLAT with peak=C_T,clear sigma0/trough. Otherwise remainHELD target1. Rolling sigma missing/zero never substitutes for or changes locked sigma0.
prospective_policy.boundary_and_scale: All three event comparisons use >= on log-price differences, no numeric tolerance at decisions. Positive proportional price rescaling preserves ideal log geometry; float values at exact boundaries require explicit machine arithmetic audit, no added epsilon. Prices must be positive finite.
prospective_policy.causality: T17 uses only complete Close and past returns throughT. Intent is processed by existing native execution onT+1, with normal fixed1% limit entry/real sell contract. First unavoidable overnight and later failed-limit/state differences are accounted by native engine, not made into T-known profits.
prospective_policy.signal_vs_account: HELD and target1 are signal-policy intent. A limit buy can fail or execute later; actual quantity,filled cycles,fees and cash remain native-account facts. No fabricated target transitions counted as closed trades, no microposition count padding, no claim that signal holdings equal actual positions.
prospective_policy.validity: Unique timezone-naive normalized positive-price session index; evaluation signal sessions must be a nonempty contiguous subset of complete price sessions. Warmup and any future price tail can exist; future prices do not enter decisions. An invalid full source is rejected rather than silently repaired.
